clusters.headline: Delhi Tightens Air Pollution Measures As AQI Levels Remain Elevated
aiSummaryBullets: Authorities have activated Stage III of the Graded Response Action Plan as the Air Quality Index reached 364.
The Supreme Court of India identified vehicular emissions as a primary factor contributing to pollution in the capital and surrounding areas.

clusters.headline: Sonia Gandhi Reflects On Life And Politics In New Memoir Belonging
aiSummaryBullets: Sonia Gandhi is set to release her memoir titled Belonging: A Journey of Love, detailing her transition from a private life to public politics.
The book covers her personal experiences with loss, her decision to decline the Prime Minister position, and her reflections on the Emergency period.

clusters.headline: Jharkhand Faces Political Unrest Following Tribal Activist's Death
aiSummaryBullets: Tribal activist Nisha Bhagat passed away on November 6 following public claims of harassment.
Bhagat had previously alleged in a live broadcast that the state government and land brokers targeted her.

clusters.headline: Rahul Gandhi Criticizes E20 Fuel Implementation Policies In India
aiSummaryBullets: Rahul Gandhi alleged that E20 fuel samples in Karnataka have exceeded established limits.
The politician characterized the E20 fuel program as a form of cheating directed at the general public.

clusters.headline: Trinamool Congress MP Abhishek Banerjee Reports Attack On Residence
aiSummaryBullets: Trinamool Congress MP Abhishek Banerjee reported an attack on his residence during his birthday celebration.
The MP claimed this incident marks the seventh attempt on his life within the last six months.

clusters.headline: Veteran Politician Sharad Pawar Discharged From Mumbai Hospital
aiSummaryBullets: Sharad Pawar was discharged from a hospital in Mumbai on November 7, 2026.
The 85-year-old politician had been undergoing medical treatment for three days.

clusters.headline: Telangana Expands Medical Seats Amid Broader Faculty Departures
aiSummaryBullets: Telangana increased its postgraduate medical seat count by 359 across state-run institutions for the 2026-27 academic year.
The expansion brings the total state government medical intake to 1,625 seats across 23 colleges.

clusters.headline: Political Tensions Rise Over Viral Video And Debate Challenges
aiSummaryBullets: The Bharatiya Janata Party criticized Rahul Gandhi for sharing a video of Amit Shah they claim was presented out of context.
Rahul Gandhi challenged Amit Shah to facilitate a public debate between himself and Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

clusters.headline: Significant Archaeological Find And Criminal Case Report In India
aiSummaryBullets: A 17-year-old American student identified an Egyptian scarab amulet from the Late Bronze Age at Tel Gezer National Park in Israel.
The 3,300-year-old artifact contains royal cobra imagery and is currently held by the Israel Antiquities Authority.

clusters.headline: Diverse Policy Issues Emerging Within The Karnataka State Government
aiSummaryBullets: Stakeholders are raising objections to a state government proposal requiring private schools to adopt government-run institutions.
State authorities have identified instances of petrol being retailed with ethanol concentrations exceeding 30 percent.
